summary: Preserve canonical ticket branches during PR publication

delivery.outcome: New canonical ticket branches retain the same branch identity during protected PR publication, with explicit legacy PR reuse and no duplicate remote delivery.
nonGoals: No dependency manifests or bootstrap edits; tickets 100/101 retain their scopes.
No Planfile controller, managed adoption or release changes.

architecture.decision: Resolve canonical ticket branches at the existing controlled publication boundary; retain legacy transport only for existing open PRs or legacy workspaces.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material commit; existing remote branches and PRs remain preserved.

validation.evidence: Canonical name, ticket mismatch, legacy reuse, ambiguous PR and API failure regressions.
Exact scope and protected CI plus independent Validator before merge.
